theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_flat_sub
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T₁ T₂ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (a b : ℤ), IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₂ → (∀ ω, S ω = (a : ℝ) * T₁ ω + (b : ℝ) * T₂ ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (R₁ R₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (S₁ S₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsIntegerMultiplicity R₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity R₂ → IsIntegerMultiplicity S₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity S₂ → ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω, R.boundary ω + S ω = (R₁.boundary ω + S₁ ω) - (R₂.boundary ω + S₂ ω)) ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ (R₁.mass + S₁.mass) + (R₂.mass + S₂.mass)
